title: Highward's barracks — the single location packed with fellow soldiers, guards, a sergeant and a Captain-General — never offered a single '(as a Warden)' dialogue option, even though a Warden is explicitly 'a soldier of the old watch'; the one place a soldier's bearing should land with living peers was silent, while a swamp tower's ghost recognized it instantly.
